command: set -euo pipefail; echo NOW=$(date -Ins); echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); echo SERVICE; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ActiveEnterTimestamp; echo CHROME; pgrep -af '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true; echo WINDOWS; for w in $(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'FranKenstein -- live' 2>/dev/null || true); do echo W=$w; xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell $w || true; xprop -id $w WM_CLASS WM_NAME 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo JOURNAL; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-buehne.service --since '2026-09-12 03:12:30 UTC' --no-pager -n 120 || true; echo RECENT_SHELL; ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -E 'avatar_singleton_refresh|frankenstein-buehne|google-chrome.*127.0.0.1:8788' | grep -v grep || true
